observations: Photo 0 shows a bare automotive engine assembly sitting on bare ground/pavement, disconnected from any vehicle.
Wiring harness, intake manifold, and various sensors/hoses are visible, still attached and dangling.
A watermark reading 'TI AUTOMOBILE' is overlaid on the image, appears to be a dealer/reseller stamp, not a vehicle marking.
No engine code, serial number, manufacturer logo, or part plate is legible anywhere on the block or covers.
Surface is dusty/dirty with some visible grime on the block, consistent with a used pull from a vehicle.
No stand, crate, or packaging visible; engine rests directly on concrete/tarmac, raising risk of debris ingress into ports.
No visible turbo, alternator, or starter motor in frame; unclear if these are included or already removed.

identity.kind: used car engine (complete assembly with wiring harness)

claims.evidence: No import documents, container photo, or markings in photo 0 to confirm direct import origin.

risks.risk: Make/model and engine code are unknown, which is the single biggest driver of an engine's value and buyer compatibility.
risks.proof: Close-up photo of the stamped engine code/serial plate on the block, or a photo of the engine bay/VIN plate of the donor car.
risks.if_unproven: cannot be priced at all without this, since price ranges across engine types are too wide

risks.risk: Unknown whether the engine runs or has internal damage (compression, timing, bearings).
risks.proof: A start-up video showing the engine running smoothly with no unusual noise or smoke.

risks.risk: Possible missing ancillary parts (turbo, alternator, starter, sensors) not visible in frame.
risks.proof: Full 360-degree photo set showing all sides of the engine including front and rear faces.

risks.risk: Mileage/history of the donor vehicle is unknown.
risks.proof: Photo of odometer or service history sticker from the donor car if available.

risks.risk: Engine sitting on bare ground exposes open ports to dirt/debris ingress, risking contamination.
risks.proof: Photo showing ports covered/plugged, or confirmation of how it was stored before listing.

proof_requests: Close-up photo of the engine code/serial number stamped on the block.
Start-up video of the engine running.
Photos from all sides (front, rear, both flanks, top, bottom) to confirm completeness.
Photo of the donor vehicle or its VIN/engine bay for cross-reference.
Odometer or mileage documentation from donor vehicle, if available.
response.reason: The engine's make, model, and engine code are not legible in the single photo, and this is the key fact that sets any price range for a used engine; without it, even a worst-case price cannot be assigned.
